key.name: show-icon
key.description: Whether to show the Firecrawl icon in the top panel

key.name: show-panel-bar
key.description: Whether to show the progress bar in the top panel

key.name: show-panel-text
key.description: Whether to show the remaining-credits label in the top panel

key.name: proxy-url
key.description: HTTP proxy URL (e.g., http://localhost:11809). Leave empty to use no proxy.

key.name: warn-on-low-runway
key.summary: Warn when balance is projected to run out soon (ALPHA)
key.description: Project current burn rate (from usage history) forward; if the credit balance is on track to hit zero within runway-warn-days, blink the panel bar red. Alpha feature — default off.

key.name: runway-warn-days
key.description: Blink the warning when projected days-to-zero falls at or below this many days

key.name: flash-on-refresh
key.description: Brief flash each time a live poll succeeds

key.name: csv-export-dir
key.description: Directory the user last saved a usage-history CSV export to, remembered across sessions so the save dialog reopens there
